response.sql: SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) as avg_aCL_IgM FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.`ANA Pattern` IS NULL OR e.`ANA Pattern` != 'S' GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Examinations with NULL ANA Pattern are included (interpreted as 'don't show S'), since they do not show the 'S' pattern, only the absence of any pattern

alternatives.interpretation: Only include examinations with a recorded (non-NULL) ANA Pattern that is not 'S', excluding both NULL and 'S' values
alternatives.sql: SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) as avg_aCL_IgM FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.`ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND e.`ANA Pattern` != 'S' GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10

alternatives.interpretation: Only include patients who have no examination record with ANA Pattern = 'S' at all (patient-level filter), averaging across all remaining exams
alternatives.sql: SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) as avg_aCL_IgM FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10
